name: Specular 높음light
algorithm: Specular 높음light — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method analyzes specular highlights for deepfake detection:

1. **Highlight감지**: Specular highlights (bright spots from direct light reflection) are detected across the frame on all surfaces — skin, eyes, glasses, jewelry, objects. Highlights are identified by local maximum intensity exceeding neighbors by a threshold.

2. **Highlight-빛Source일관성**: All specular highlights in the scene should be consistent with the same light source configuration. Using highlight positions and surface geometry, the method estimates implied light directions. All highlights should point to consistent light source positions. Deepfakes may produce highlights with inconsistent implied light directions.

3. **HighlightShape분석**: The shape of specular highlights encodes surface curvature — highlights on flat surfaces appear as points, on curved surfaces as elongated reflections following surface curvature. The method checks highlight shapes against estimated surface geometry. AI-generated highlights may have shapes inconsistent with the underlying geometry.

4. **HighlightIntensity&Physics**: Specular highlight intensity follows the Fresnel equations — brighter at grazing angles, with material-dependent characteristics. The method verifies highlight intensity follows physical reflectance models. AI generators may produce highlights with incorrect intensity patterns.

5. **시간적HighlightDynamics**: As objects move, specular highlights should move according to the changing reflection angle. The method tracks highlight motion — highlights should move faster than texture features for convex surfaces (virtual image effect). Incorrect highlight dynamics indicate AI generation without proper reflectance modeling.

accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through specular highlight analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats

limitations:
